output.answer_or_partial: John describes the camping trip with Max as a peaceful, enjoyable break in nature. They hiked and swam, spent quality time together, and made great memories; he says it helped him reset and appreciate life’s little things.
output.explanation: John directly recounts the trip and its activities, atmosphere, and personal effect.

evidence.quote: Max and I had a blast on our camping trip last summer. We hiked, swam, and made great memories. It was a really peaceful and awesome experience.
Being out in nature, away from all the noise and taking some quality time was great. It was a nice break from the everyday hustle and bustle.
Yeah, it was like restarting my mind and spirit.
